title: LBJ locks himself in the Air Force One bathroom

tellings.quote: Jack valante told me all about it Jack valante was with him okay so that's right jack Val was with him he locked himself in the bathroom on Air Force One

plain: In Dallas in 1963, Lyndon B. Johnson is said to have locked himself in the bathroom on Air Force One, the president's plane. Dan Sheehan, a lawyer who has worked on several famous American cases, tells Michels he heard this from Jack Valenti, a Johnson aide who was with him at the time. The story is told as a glimpse of Johnson's state of mind in those hours.
